title: endiandra insignis
intro: Endiandra insignis, commonly known as the Black Ash, is a species of plant in the family Lauraceae. It is a tree native to Australia, known for its timber and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Endiandra insignis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Endiandra insignis include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antiviral, and antiparasitic activities.
